findings.evidence: An `instance foo : C := inferInstance` elaborates before `foo` enters the environment, so the search that succeeds is Mathlib's. grep: `Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Cotangent.lean:313:instance [IsNoetherianRing R] : FiniteDimensional (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R)`; `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dual/Lemmas.lean:507:instance instModuleDualFiniteDimensional [FiniteDimensional K V] : FiniteDimensional K (Module.Dual K V)`; `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Noetherian.lean:349:instance [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {x : X} : IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)`.
findings.fix: Delete both instances. Nothing downstream breaks: every use site resolves through the Mathlib chain, exactly as the `inferInstance` bodies demonstrate.
findings.issue: `finiteDimensional_zariskiCotangentSpace` (line 64) and `finiteDimensional_zariskiTangentSpace` (line 71) both have body `inferInstance`. Since `ZariskiCotangentSpace`/`ZariskiTangentSpace` are reducible `abbrev`s, typeclass search already reaches Mathlib's instances without them: `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Noetherian.lean:349` (`[IsLocallyNoetherian X] → IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)`) feeds `Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Cotangent.lean:313` (`instance [IsNoetherianRing R] : FiniteDimensional (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R)`), and that feeds `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dual/Lemmas.lean:507` (`instModuleDualFiniteDimensional`).

findings.evidence: Body at line 82 is `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq`; `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dual/Lemmas.lean:512: @[simp] theorem dual_finrank_eq : finrank K (Module.Dual K V) = finrank K V`. The only two consumers are line 91 of the same file and AbelianVariety/TangentSpace.lean:173.
findings.fix: Delete the lemma. At line 91 replace it with `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq` in the `rw`, and at `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AbelianVariety/TangentSpace.lean:173` likewise (`rw [finrank_tangentSpace_eq_finrank_residueField, Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]`).
findings.issue: `finrank_zariskiTangentSpace_eq_finrank_zariskiCotangentSpace` is Mathlib's `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq` — its proof is literally that term, and with the reducible abbrevs unfolded the statements coincide. Mathlib's version is even `@[simp]`, so `simp` closes both call sites.

findings.evidence: Lines 137-140 are `by let _ : IsLocallyNoetherian A.toScheme := …; infer_instance` — i.e. the statement follows by pure instance search once `IsLocallyNoetherian A.toScheme` is available, via `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Noetherian.lean:349` → `Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Cotangent.lean:313` → `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dual/Lemmas.lean:507`.
findings.fix: Promote that to a top-level `instance : IsLocallyNoetherian A.toScheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian A.toOver.hom` (naturally in `AbelianVariety/Basic.lean`) and delete `finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_residueField`; the Mathlib instance chain then fires automatically, and `finiteDimensional_tangentSpace` (line 143) still works via `Module.Finite.trans`.
findings.issue: `finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_residueField` re-derives the same finiteness a third time; its only content is the proof-local `let _ : IsLocallyNoetherian A.toScheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian A.toOver.hom` (line 138), which is hidden inside the proof where no other declaration can use it.

summary: Three of the six declarations in TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/TangentSpace/Basic.lean are verbatim restatements of Mathlib declarations that directly replace them (two instances whose bodies are `inferInstance`, one lemma whose body is `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq`), and the abelian-variety file re-derives the same finiteness instance a fourth time. The genuinely new material (`finrank_zariskiTangentSpace_eq_coheight`, the residue-field identification at the identity) is fine.
